name: Bank Select MSB
hardware: transmitted on every sound change, as CC 0 = 63 then CC 32 then a Program Change — that measurement was taken with the SEQTRAK as USB device, from a Mac. Re-confirmed 2026-10-22 with the SEQTRAK as USB host and an ESP32 USB-MIDI device as the receiver: 232 occurrences, exactly equal to CC 32, so no orphan MSB in 232 sound changes. The bus role does not change this behaviour.
